title: 03/19/21 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 03/19/21 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078528 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. We fixed an issue which was affecting the automatic installation of SSL certificates on on older servers in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing Forms from displaying the custom text label for validation errors below form fields in some cases. We added a recommended image size to the Social Media Shared Image when using the Web Page Builder in the Admin. We created a new Advanced Setting called "Categories Page URL" in order to easily edit the URL used for the categories page instead of having to edit Widgets and Menus that link to this page. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Sub Level Categories Bootstrap Theme - Display - Top Categories Menu Involved: Footer Menu We updated the layout of the Edit Form Settings modal when editing the Forms in the Admin. We updated the Froala WYSIWYG Image Settings in the Admin in order to add the ability to hide images on mobile devices. We fixed an issue which was preventing users from saving the Billing Email Settings in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to change the Origin Page value of a Lead when editing leads in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from fetching images on the Member Images page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to display expired events on the Recent Events widget on the homepage when the Auto-Recurring Events Add-On is active in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Events We created a Keyword Filter field when editing Forms in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Membership Plan revenue from displaying on the Membership Plans page in the Admin when the name of the Membership Plan contained an apostrophe. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to remove backslashes "\" from CSS rules on the CSS tab when editing widgets in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to display the List View icon on mobile devices even when is the only option to display. We improved the validation of the Available Upgrade Options feature when editing Membership Plans in order to remove any HTML from the Membership Plan's name when displaying as an upgrade option in the Member Dashboard. We fixed a conflict with the "Add NO FOLLOW to Member Web Links" Membership Plan setting which caused embedded HTML on member profile pages to break in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab The validation category text when trying to submit a Lead is now controlled by Text Labels. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Category Dropdowns We fixed an issue which was causing the system to display Member Review Images on Multi-Photo Post Types post in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums datatable Bootstrap Theme - Search Results - Display Image Slider We removed the "Accepted" status from the Lead Status dropdown on the Lead Details column on the Manage Leads page of the Admin. We updated the logic of the "Google Map Pin Drop" setting to also use the chosen image on the Lead Map field in the Website - Lead Form - Get Matched form. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Lead Map We updated the Send Newsletter page logic in order to redirect to the Send Newsletter page after creating/deleting a Newsletter in the Admin. We created a new setting called "Font Family" for the Recent Post Title used by homepage streaming widgets. In order to use this new setting, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Hompage tab >> Enable Additional Sections >> Section Title Font. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings Bootstrap Theme - HEAD We fixed an issue which preventing the system from displaying the correct error message when trying to collect a payment from the Admin when using a Payment Gateway other than Stripe. We created a new Brand Image Setting called "Default Post Thumbnail" in order to set a default post image to use when a member publishes a post without an image. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Search Results - Display Image Slider For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
